description: SymBA* is a cost-optimal planner that runs symbolic bidirectional Dijkstra and adds heuristics only when the search gets hard. When the next set of one side grows past a node limit, that side first runs a search in an *abstraction*: a smaller task that drops variables or low bits of variables. This abstract search runs in the opposite direction and gives a *perimeter* heuristic: closed abstract states get their exact distance, all others the smallest open cost. The heuristic never overestimates, so the bidirectional stop bound stays valid and the plan is optimal; an abstract search that grows too large is frozen, and a coarser one starts. With a budget, the search can stop early and report the best plan so far and a lower bound.
